prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.angle: Position Tylor as a hands-on systems architect who has shipped rule-driven, validated backend configurations and client onboarding integrations, bringing operational rigor from military supply and enterprise account work to CentralReach's configuration role.
posting_hooks: Translating business and implementation requirements into backend system configurations, supported by Tylor's database-layer validation pipeline that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.

Provisioning and configuring customer accounts across internal systems, supported by the linkme-intops operations CRM module for high-value subscription accounts and integration blueprints for enterprise client onboarding.
Configuring AI rule settings and workflows with attention to detail, supported by LangGraph agents with human approval steps and an eval suite that gates on unsupported claims.
